name: B10-0184/2025 (S&D) – Unlawful detention and sham trials of Armenian hostages, including high-ranking political representatives from Nagorno-Karabakh, by Azerbaijan
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the unlawful detention and sham trials of Armenian hostages, including high-ranking political representatives from Nagorno-Karabakh, by Azerbaijan
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for the release of Armenians held in Azerbaijan, including former leaders from Nagorno-Karabakh. It says their trials are unfair and that some have been tortured. It asks Azerbaijan to follow international law, asks the European Union to send medical and humanitarian teams to check on the prisoners, and asks the Council to sanction Azerbaijani officials, including three named judges. It also condemns Azerbaijan for closing United Nations and Red Cross offices. This is an opinion; the text does not itself change any law.

- Nothing changes yet: the Parliament is asking, not deciding.
- It affects Armenian detainees in Azerbaijan and the named Azerbaijani officials.
- Next, the Council may consider sanctions; the EU may send aid teams.
